claims: American Horror Story Season 13 is set to premiere around Halloween 2026.
Filming for American Horror Story Season 13 takes place in New York City from April 6 to July 22, 2026.
Jessica Lange returns to the American Horror Story franchise for the first time since Apocalypse (Season 8).

Confirmed cast members for American Horror Story Season 13 include Jessica Lange, Sarah Paulson, Evan Peters, Emma Roberts, Angela Bassett, Kathy Bates, Billie Lourd, Gabourey Sidibe, Leslie Grossman, and Ariana Grande.
American Horror Story Season 13 is rumored to be titled Tenants.
